title: drymocallis glandulosa subsp. ashlandica
intro: Drymocallis glandulosa subsp. ashlandica, commonly known as Ashland sticky geranium, is a plant species belonging to the Rosaceae family. The health benefits of Ashland sticky geranium include its ability to act as a diuretic, helping to reduce water retention and alleviate symptoms associated with urinary tract issues. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its analgesic and anti-inflammatory properties, which can help alleviate pain and reduce inflammation in the body. The bioactive constituents of Ashland sticky geranium include phenolic acids and flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and contribute to its therapeutic actions.
